title: Presensi Wajah: Sistem Presensi Kuliah Berbasis Pengenalan Wajah di Peramban
description: Face-recognition attendance system for university classes at Universitas IPWIJA. Static build-free frontend (app-presensi) and Cloudflare Workers + D1 backend (api-presensi). Face feature extraction (face-api.js) runs in the browser; only an encrypted 128-D descriptor is stored, never images or video. Includes active liveness challenges, explicit biometric consent, role-based access (student, lecturer, admin), per-meeting reports with manual override, and CSV export. Note: tests so far use mocked face models; liveness thresholds still require calibration on real devices.
